title: Diannina přeměna
scope: Repair the one incorrect completion NPC in inherited SQL; preserve quest rules, rewards and character progress.

defect.reported: The completed quest navigates to Karl but cannot be turned in there.
defect.effect: The server offers completion at NPC 20004 instead of Karl. The repaired client selects a completion offered by the current NPC, so it cannot send the completion action at Karl.

reference.quest_identity: Pinned quest 8006 has hunt kind 290 and fetch item 9657; pinned completion 8007 references mission 8006.

history_review.result: Preserve the Map's NPC identity/map/country validation and normal completion dispatch; do not accept an arbitrary mission ID as a completion.
Retain item/reward prevalidation, ingredient preservation, magic-item and skill corrections. No production .NET behavior changes are required for the NPC data repair.
Retain the client's completed-dialog action: resolve the QT_COMPLETE offered by the current NPC instead of selecting an unrelated global completion.

history_review.scope: Existing SQL quest checkpoints and current source
history_review.result: Retain current main-session, admission, durable checkpoint and repeat-reward guards. Their regression suites pass alongside the new quest-specific cases.

repair.guards: Require the expected completion type/parent/NPC, mission identity, sole completion term and Karl on map 0. Unknown data aborts the transaction. Already repaired data is accepted.

validation.actor_coverage: Karl offers completion; old NPC does not. Satisfied kill/fetch completes, consumes the crystal and rewards only once. Missing kill or crystal still rejects without rewards or lost eligibility.
validation.sql_coverage: A fresh generated 4DevQuestTest_dianna_* database copies only static chart rows. Repair changes only the intended field; a second application is idempotent. Unexpected NPC, changed objective and missing Karl fail atomically. Fixture is removed in finally; no player rows are copied.

remaining: Actual client dialog, turn-in and completion persistence after relog need user/client acceptance.

This repair does not certify the whole quest graph or its rewards. The pinned mission also contains RT_SOUL=374 and six selectable magic rewards 2238/2243/2248/2253/2258/2263 absent from the inherited SQL reward list. Existing RT_SOUL support and exact reward reconciliation remain incomplete; no reward is inferred or silently substituted here.
Full Gameforge baseline, distributed ownership and the exact pinned executable release remain unverified.
